name: Homebrew to KPM
description: Self-hosted KPM repository for porting jailbroken-Kindle homebrew extensions to KPM packages.

helloworld.name: Hello World
helloworld.author: TODO_YOUR_NAME
helloworld.description: Minimal test package to validate the install/launch/uninstall pipeline before porting real homebrew extensions.

bluetooth_toggle.name: Bluetooth Toggle
bluetooth_toggle.author: GreenCat777
bluetooth_toggle.description: Enable/Disable Bluetooth via lipc-set-prop, ported from GreenCat777's KUAL-era package. India-region Kindles ship with Bluetooth disabled unless Audible is supported; this forces it on/off manually.

lark.name: LARK Audiobook Player
lark.author: kbarni
lark.description: M4B/MP3 audiobook player with chapter and bookmark support (KinAMP audio engine, FAAD2 decoder). Audio output is Bluetooth-only on this device -- enable Bluetooth first via the bluetooth_toggle package. Ported from kbarni/LARKPlayer v2.8.1 (GPLv3) to the KPM package format.

telnet.name: Telnet
telnet.author: Foskya
telnet.description: SECURITY: opens an UNAUTHENTICATED root shell (telnetd -l /bin/sh, no password) on port 23 for any device on the same Wi-Fi network, unencrypted. Only use on a trusted local network. Tap the screen to stop the server. Ported from kindlemodshelf.me/telnet (author Foskya) to the KPM package format.

sshd.name: SSH Server (Persistent)
sshd.author: Mr.13
sshd.description: Persistent SSH server. Reuses KOReader's bundled dropbear binary and host key, but launches it detached (setsid) so the session survives KOReader being closed. Requires KOReader installed. Start/Stop from the library. Root shell on port 2222.
